name: Swing Light
description: A lamp shape swings back and forth over dark SVG letters, lighting them up with a soft glowing beam as it passes, on a solid background.
contents: Dark SVG lettering spelling a word
Swinging lamp mask revealing a lit copy of the letters with a glow
behavior: Lamp mask swings between two angles in an endless yoyo loop
Lit letters are visible only under the lamp and clipped to the letter shapes
Animation is stopped and reverted on unmount
editableByProps: Background, unlit and lit letter colors
Swing speed, angle and pivot point

needsCodeEdit.where: path with id lamp inside the lightMask mask

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Lettering is fixed SVG path data, not text
Uses fixed element ids (mainSVG, lamp, glow, lightMask, lightTextMask), so only one instance per page
